preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == 3 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 if line == stdin.splitlines()[1] else len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly three lines: first line has three space-separated integers, second line has two, and third line has one.

preconditions.expression: all(h >= 0 and h <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() for h in map(int, line.split()))
preconditions.description: All Hamming distances are non-negative integers not exceeding 10^5.

preconditions.expression: any(h > 0 for line in stdin.splitlines() for h in map(int, line.split()))
preconditions.description: At least one Hamming distance is positive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 5 and len(stdout.splitlines()[0]) > 0 and all(len(line) == int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or a valid set of four strings of equal length, where the first line is the length and the next four lines are the strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda d: all(d[s1][s2] == d[s2][s1] for s1 in d for s2 in d if s1 != s2))(dict(zip([(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3),(2,3)], map(int, [stdin.split()[0], stdin.split()[1], stdin.split()[2], stdin.splitlines()[1].split()[0], stdin.splitlines()[1].split()[1], stdin.splitlines()[2].split()[0]])))) == (lambda: (lambda s: all(s[i][j] == sum(1 for k in range(len(s[0])) if s[0][k] != s[1][k]) for i in [(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3),(2,3)]))(stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the Hamming distances between the four output strings match the input distances exactly.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(c in 'ab' for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
postconditions.description: All output strings consist only of lowercase letters 'a' and 'b'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda: (lambda s: len(s[0]))(stdout.splitlines()[1:])) == min(len(s) for s in [stdout.splitlines()[1:]] if stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(c in 'ab' for line in s for c in line) and (lambda d: all(d[s1][s2] == d[s2][s1] for s1 in d for s2 in d if s1 != s2))(dict(zip([(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3),(2,3)], map(int, [stdin.split()[0], stdin.split()[1], stdin.split()[2], stdin.splitlines()[1].split()[0], stdin.splitlines()[1].split()[1], stdin.splitlines()[2].split()[0]])))) == (lambda: (lambda s: all(s[i][j] == sum(1 for k in range(len(s[0])) if s[0][k] != s[1][k]) for i in [(0,1),(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3),(2,3)]))(s)))
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the length of the strings is minimal among all possible valid solutions.
